title: AtScale Failures by Cube
app: AtScale engine query logs and the AtScale API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=atscale:query status="ERROR"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by cube_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts AtScale failures grouped by cube so operators immediately see which specific cubes are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'AtScale is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest AtScale failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical cubes.
visualization: Table of cube by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of AtScale are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
